origin.description: The capability data frame has 75 rows and 1 columns. The data are simulated successive observations from a process in equilibrium. The process is assumed to have specification limits (5.49, 5.79).
origin.details: This data frame contains the following column: y: The simulated measurements. Source: The data were obtained from Bissell, A.F. (1990) How reliable is your capability index? Applied Statistics, 39, 331--340. Canty, A.J. and Davison, A.C. (1996) Implementation of saddlepoint approximations to resampling distributions. To appear in Computing Science and Statistics; Proceedings of the 28th Symposium on the Interface. Davison, A.C. and Hinkley, D.V. (1997) Bootstrap Methods and Their Application. Cambridge University Press.
origin.value: A data frame with 75 rows and 1 columns: y.
